claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantSenseOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Locate Object grants the caster a continuous directional sense of a target object for the concentration duration. This is an ongoing_effect spell (self attachment, concentration), but OngoingOperation only allows roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A grant_sense variant is needed to represent passive divination/detection operations. The v4 taxonomy already lists grant_sense in the Effect Atoms (section 9); what is missing is the OngoingOperation variant that wires it into the ongoing_effect family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You sense the direction to the object's location if that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.
